content.text: UX copy review passed; enabling on production signup.
Signup only checks minimum length today. Weak and previously breached passwords still get accepted until a later forced reset.

On the signup password field, show a strength meter (entropy-style score 0–4) and an async check against our common-breach bloom filter service. Block submit on score < 2 or a breach hit; show actionable guidance without listing the password in logs.
Done when the check debounces at 300ms, fails open with a warning if the breach service times out after 800ms, and the same component is reused on password change.
